title: Phone number field accepts invalid values without validation message
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in SignupFlow, the user encountered: Phone number field accepts invalid values without validation message.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Create account
2. Observe UI state: Continue
3. Observe UI state: Welcome

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Welcome.

## Environment
- App: SignupFlow
- Platform: web
